materials.processing_method: Conventional solid-state ceramic technique: Stoichiometric amounts of precursors LiNO3 (10 wt% excess), La2O3 (preheated at 900 °C for 24 h), Nb2O5, and Y(NO3)3 were ball milled at 200 rpm for 12 h in 2-propanol using zirconium balls. The mixture was heat treated (calcined) at 700 °C for 6 h, followed by a second ball milling under the same conditions.
